item.title: Bungo Beef: Oita's Premium Wagyu — Guide
item.description: Bungo beef (Bungo-gyu), named after Oita’s historic Bungo province, is the prefecture’s premium brand of wagyu and a source of great local pride. Reared to strict standards on Oita’s rich natural pastures and pure water, the black-haired cattle produce beef renowned for its exquisite fine marbling, tenderness and deep, sweet flavour, ranking it among Japan’s fine regional wagyu. The low-melting-point fat gives it a rich, buttery texture that melts in the mouth.
